roles.requirements: Degree in a highly technical field (CS, engineering, statistics, maths or physics) required | Strong statistics and machine learning with practical experience on noisy real-world data | Solid software development skills in Java, C++ or Python | Demonstrable interest in systematic trading, internship experience preferred | Low ego, effective collaboratively and autonomously

The title signals new-grad intake, which is a mild mismatch for someone ~18 months into a role by start date, but unlike most new-grad reqs at peer firms there is no 'graduating in 20XX' language to disqualify on. Feb 2026 EPFL MSc is recent enough that this is still arguably in-window.

existing_rows_audit.detail: Office is real and confirmed on the firm's own site (WTC Tower 2, Level 3, Strawinskylaan 1847), and a C++ req is genuinely open there, but the posted title is 'C++ Software Developer', not 'Software Engineer (C++)'. Two further corrections to that row: the 'Verification Status: Reported' can be upgraded to verified-primary, and the 'New-grad OR entry-level req' eligibility note is wrong - the C++ posting carries no new-grad or entry-level gate at all and explicitly accepts 'extensive professional software development experience' in place of a degree. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/headlandstechnologiesllc/jobs/4227758009

Chicago HQ is real (110 North Wacker Drive, 54th Floor) and the same C++ req lists Chicago as a location, so the row is substantively right, but the posted title is 'C++ Software Developer' and the 'New-grad OR entry-level req' eligibility note is again unsupported by the posting. Note this row is out of scope for this pass anyway - the brief excludes US offices. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/headlandstechnologiesllc/jobs/4227758009

notes:
Careers flow: headlandstech.com/careers/ redirects into a Greenhouse board at job-boards.greenhouse.io/headlandstechnologiesllc. Both pages loaded cleanly; nothing was blocked, so coverage of live reqs should be complete as of 2026-08-04. The board carries only seven postings total, and each engineering/research req is a single multi-location posting where the candidate selects a city, so the Amsterdam and London rows above share req IDs rather than being distinct openings - expect one pipeline per req, not per city.

In-scope offices are Amsterdam, London and Singapore, all three confirmed on the firm's own locations page. Chicago, New York and Austin exist but are US and therefore out of scope. There is no Tokyo, Hong Kong, Shanghai or any other EU office beyond Amsterdam - do not add one.

Singapore is confirmed as a real office (Asia Square Tower 1, 8 Marina View #14-06) but currently has no in-scope openings: its only postings are 'Legal & Compliance Associate' (out of scope) and the catch-all 'Opportunistic Applications'. That catch-all does include Singapore as a location, so it is the only route into that office right now.

Deliberate omissions: 'Java Software Developer' (Amsterdam/London) is a real open systems role but falls outside all four in-scope tracks since the work is Java, not C++ - worth knowing it exists if the candidate is flexible. 'Opportunistic Applications' is a resume catch-all rather than a specific req, so it is not listed as a role.

No Trader and no ML Performance openings exist at this firm right now - the board has no trading-seat or GPU/ML-infrastructure req in any location, in scope or out. The candidate's GPU-kernel work would have to be pitched into the C++ or Quantitative Researcher reqs.

Compensation: left empty everywhere on purpose. No figure is stated on any posting, and the Netherlands and UK have no pay-transparency disclosure on these reqs. The existing sheet's EUR 90-140k Amsterdam and USD 300-400k Chicago figures are not sourced to anything I could verify on the firm's own materials - treat them as unverified estimates rather than stated ranges.
